name: KYC approved → spawn ccash account grain
description: When a Simple-KYC case is approved, autonomously spawn a ccash account grain configured for the new client.

name: Account opened → spawn client portal grain
description: When an Account Opening case completes with executive sign-off, spawn the client-facing portal grain and share it with the holder.

name: High-value four-eyes review
description: Spawn a process grain to route a high-value transaction through executive sign-off. Used by the high-value hook gate.
